messages:
incbot: P1 alert — latency SLO breach detected for customer 'Magellan Systems' in eu-west-1 dedicated pool. p95=1.8s p99=3.1s (SLO p99<=1.5s). Impact: ~42% of requests above SLO. Auto-triage: sustained qps spike + KV cache miss rate up. Paging sarah.

pagerduty: Paging sarah (oncall) for INC-6428754321 :rotating_light:

sarah (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing context and timeline.

sarah (oncall): @rajiv can you jump in to assist with tenant isolation? suspect noisy tenant in pool.

rajiv (eng-sre): joining. pulling metrics now. link to dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd (redacted)

rajiv (eng-sre): quick summary from metrics: two tenants with elevated tail latency — tid-239 (magellan-prod) and tid-742 (thirdparty-analytics). tid-742 GPU utilization spiked 3x and KV miss rate up.

lena (support): Drafting a customer-facing note: "We are investigating elevated latency in EU region affecting some requests. No data loss. Will update in 30m." Send now or wait for mitigation?

carmel (acct-mgr): Hold until we have at least a short mitigation line. want to avoid alarming them.

rajiv (eng-sre): Proposed mitigation plan (quick):
1) apply per-tenant rate limit on tid-742 to throttle noisy queries
2) evict tid-742 to warm-spare node group (graceful eviction)
3) shift 15% Magellan traffic to fallback quantized model variant to reduce token latency
4) allow autoscaler to add up to +2 GPUs if latency not recovered within 5m

sarah (oncall): OK. rajiv — please run eviction and throttles. post commands here. i'll coordinate customer comms after first signal.

rajiv (eng-sre): eviction + throttle commands:
```
# throttle tenant
./adminctl set-rate-limit --tenant tid-742 --qps 50
# evict to warm spare
./orchestrator evict --tenant tid-742 --target warm-spare --grace 30 --timeout 300
```

rajiv (eng-sre): running throttle now.

devops-bot: Rate limit applied to tid-742 (50 qps).

rajiv (eng-sre): kicking eviction in 15s.

devops-bot: Eviction job 9832 started for tenant tid-742. ETA ~120s.

sarah (oncall): watching p99 graph. stand by.

rajiv (eng-sre): eviction finished, rebalancing started.

sarah (oncall): p99 dropped from 3.1s -> 1.6s at ~90s after eviction. still slightly above SLO but trending.

rajiv (eng-sre): initiating traffic shift to quantized fallback for Magellan:
```
router set-weight magellan model-quantized=0.15
```

devops-bot: Router weights updated for Magellan: quantized=15%.

sarah (oncall): p99 now 1.3s, p95 0.9s. looks stable so far. continuing to monitor for 20m.

lena (support): Recommend we send interim update to Magellan: "Mitigation applied; latency improving; monitoring. Next update in 30m." Approve?

carmel (acct-mgr): yes send that. i'll also loop in their SRE and PS contact. keep language calm.

rajiv (eng-sre): leaving autoscaler on for +2 GPUs as precaution. current headroom ~12%. will scale if trend reverses.

sarah (oncall): Good. I'll put a note in the incident doc and hand off monitoring to rajiv — i need to go offline in ~30m.

rajiv (eng-sre): taking over incident monitoring for next 3h. I'll start an incident follow-up ticket and gather logs for RCA (KV eviction traces, tenant query profiles).

incbot: Incident INC-6428754321 - service restored. Please run RCA and customer summary. :white_check_mark:

sarah (oncall): ack. thanks team. final action items: rajiv to collect RCA artifacts, lena + carmel to prepare customer-facing summary, follow-up postmortem within 48h. closing channel for active mitigation.

carmel (acct-mgr): sending customer note now.

sarah (oncall): closing my on-call loop for this incident — handoff complete to rajiv. :raised_hands:

rajiv (eng-sre): ack, monitoring and TODOs created in JIRA (INC-6428754321-POST).
